run_segmentation: run the DPT segmentation model on images in an input folder and save output maps
run_dpt_large: run the DPT large model with vitl16_384 backbone on images for semantic segmentation
run_dpt_hybrid: run the DPT hybrid model with vitb_rn50_384 backbone on images for semantic segmentation
run_optimized_segmentation: run the DPT segmentation model with CUDA half precision and channels last optimization enabled
run_segmentation_custom_weights: run the DPT segmentation model using a custom model weights file path
